hook: Jassy joined Amazon in 1997, conceived what became Amazon Web Services with Jeff Bezos in 2003, led AWS from its 2006 launch and was its chief executive from 2016 to 2021. He succeeded Bezos as president and CEO of Amazon on July 5, 2021. As CEO he has made AI infrastructure, including Amazon's own Trainium chips and large compute agreements with Anthropic and OpenAI, central to the company's spending plans.

quick_facts: Holds an AB from Harvard University and an MBA from Harvard Business School.
Joined Amazon in 1997 and founded and led Amazon Web Services from its inception.
Served as CEO of AWS from April 2016 until July 2021.
Became President and CEO of Amazon on July 5, 2021, and sits on the company's board.
Is a member of the National Academy of Engineering and was named to TIME's TIME100 AI list in 2025.
His 2025 letter to shareholders described AI as a multiplier across Amazon's businesses and put planned 2026 capital spending at about $200 billion.

achievements.title: Amazon Web Services
achievements.impact: Founded and led AWS from its inception, starting with a team of 57 at its 2006 launch, and ran it as CEO from 2016 to 2021.

achievements.title: Amazon Bedrock
achievements.impact: Reached general availability on September 28, 2023, giving AWS customers managed access to foundation models from several AI companies through a single API.

achievements.title: Trainium and custom AI chips
achievements.impact: Amazon's own Trainium chips are central to its AI strategy, and his 2025 shareholder letter reported that Trainium3 began shipping in early 2026.

achievements.title: Anthropic agreement
achievements.impact: Amazon agreed to invest $5 billion in Anthropic, with up to $20 billion more tied to commercial milestones, on top of $8 billion invested earlier, while Anthropic committed to spend more than $100 billion on AWS over ten years.

achievements.title: OpenAI agreement
achievements.impact: Amazon agreed to invest $50 billion in OpenAI, starting with $15 billion, and expanded OpenAI's existing $38 billion AWS agreement by $100 billion over eight years, including about 2 gigawatts of Trainium capacity.

source_basis: This profile was written mainly from the Wikipedia article on Andy Jassy, retrieved 2026-10-22, with awards, dates and current role checked against Amazon's investor relations biography, Jassy's 2025 shareholder letter, Amazon's Anthropic and OpenAI announcements, and TIME's 2025 TIME100 AI list.
